investigations.question: What kills the pilot inside the x=3300-6300 gap -- especially the 3-death cluster at x~4483 -- what happens past gate-open on x=12269-12400 and at collection, and what does each death cost in replay seconds? Stored evidence has no death cause/events, no input history, no position/tier trace, no hazard-phase data, and no gameplay frames; mistimed encounters, unfair hotspots, and policy defects are all live, and the unplayed crown approach may hold defects no finding yet names.
